rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's seventeen builder trees go (magnolias, eucalyptus, jacarandas and ficus along the back fences, a norfolk pine, a magnolia and a queen palm 2.7-3.2 m from the house fronts, others by the grills); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two grills, on the open lot corner, and two back yards.
